gloss: one or the other; either one; one of (two things)

definitions.gloss: one or the other (of two options); either one
definitions.explanation: Combines どちら (which of two) with the indefinite particle か. Picks out an unspecified one from a pair — usually translated as 'either one', 'one of the two', or 'whichever'.

examples.japanese: どちらか{選|えら}んでください。
examples.english: Please pick one of the two.

examples.japanese: どちらかと{言|い}えば{紅茶|こうちゃ}の{方|ほう}が{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: If I had to choose, I'd say I prefer black tea.

examples.japanese: {紙|かみ}か{電子版|でんしばん}か、どちらかをお{選|えら}びいただけます。
examples.english: You can choose either the paper or the digital version.

notes:
Refers to a pair, not three or more. Use どれか for three or more options. The casual contraction どっちか is extremely common in speech.

FIXED EXPRESSIONS:
- どちらかと{言|い}えば: if I had to say which; if anything
- どちらかと{言|い}うと: if one had to choose between them
- どちらか{一方|いっぽう}: one or the other (of the two)
- どちらか{選|えら}ぶ: to choose between two

SIMILAR WORDS:
- どちらも: both — covers the pair
- どちらでも: either is fine; any one will do
- どれか: any one of (three or more)
- どっちか: casual contracted form
